CREATE TABLE emoji_descriptions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL,
	emoji_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
	analysis_mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
	question_hash VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
	model VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
	prompt_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
	description TEXT NOT NULL,
	observation_json TEXT NOT NULL,
	hit_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL,
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	last_used_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY (id),
	CONSTRAINT ck_emoji_descriptions_analysis_mode CHECK (analysis_mode IN ('general', 'meme', 'ocr', 'question')),
	CONSTRAINT ck_emoji_descriptions_hit_count CHECK (hit_count >= 0),
	CONSTRAINT uq_emoji_descriptions_lookup UNIQUE (emoji_key, analysis_mode, question_hash, model, prompt_version)
)

CREATE TABLE memory_recall_receipts (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL,
	turn_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
	conversation_hash VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	trigger_hash VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	origin VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
	mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
	purpose VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
	candidate_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL,
	selected_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL,
	injected_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL,
	used_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL,
	reinforced_count INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL,
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, runtime_turn_id VARCHAR(64),
	PRIMARY KEY (id),
	CONSTRAINT uq_memory_recall_receipts_turn_id UNIQUE (turn_id),
	CONSTRAINT ck_memory_recall_receipt_mode CHECK (mode IN ('none','lexical','hybrid','overview')),
	CONSTRAINT ck_memory_recall_receipt_purpose CHECK (purpose IN ('background','recall','continuation','verify','correct'))
)

CREATE TABLE memory_claim_candidates (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL,
	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
	candidate_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
	target_scope VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
	subject_user_id VARCHAR(64),

	normalized_memory_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
	content TEXT NOT NULL,
	subject_basis VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
	retention VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
	source_style VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL,
	status VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
	evidence_count INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL,
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY (id),
	CONSTRAINT uq_memory_claim_candidates_fingerprint UNIQUE (fingerprint),
	CONSTRAINT ck_memory_claim_candidates_type CHECK (candidate_type IN ('memory','self')),
	CONSTRAINT ck_memory_claim_candidates_status CHECK (status IN ('pending','accepted','rejected','expired')),
	CONSTRAINT ck_memory_claim_candidates_evidence CHECK (evidence_count >= 1)

	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
	person_id VARCHAR(36),
	space_id VARCHAR(36),
	primary_alias_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
	primary_marker INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,

	starts_after_event_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

	CONSTRAINT fk_canonical_conversations_primary_alias FOREIGN KEY(id, primary_alias_id, primary_marker) REFERENCES conversation_legacy_aliases (conversation_id, id, is_primary) ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
	CONSTRAINT ck_canonical_conversations_id CHECK (length(id) = 36 AND id = lower(id) AND id GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-4[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[89ab][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]'),
	CONSTRAINT ck_canonical_conversations_kind CHECK (kind IN ('private', 'space')),
	CONSTRAINT ck_canonical_conversations_owner_xor CHECK ((kind = 'private' AND person_id IS NOT NULL AND space_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'space' AND space_id IS NOT NULL AND person_id IS NULL)),
	CONSTRAINT ck_canonical_conversations_person_id CHECK (person_id IS NULL OR (length(person_id) = 36 AND person_id = lower(person_id) AND person_id GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-4[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[89ab][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]')),
	CONSTRAINT ck_canonical_conversations_space_id CHECK (space_id IS NULL OR (length(space_id) = 36 AND space_id = lower(space_id) AND space_id GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-4[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[89ab][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]')),
	CONSTRAINT ck_canonical_conversations_primary_alias_id CHECK (length(primary_alias_id) = 36 AND primary_alias_id = lower(primary_alias_id) AND primary_alias_id GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-4[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[89ab][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]'),
	CONSTRAINT ck_canonical_conversations_primary_marker CHECK (primary_marker = 1),
	CONSTRAINT ck_canonical_conversations_generation CHECK (generation >= 1),
	CONSTRAINT ck_canonical_conversations_revision CHECK (revision >= 1),
	CONSTRAINT ck_canonical_conversations_watermarks CHECK (starts_after_event_id >= 0 AND last_event_id >= 0 AND last_generation_change_event_id >= 0 AND covered_through_event_id >= 0 AND uncovered_event_count >= 0 AND uncovered_character_count >= 0 AND starts_after_event_id <= last_event_id AND last_generation_change_event_id <= last_event_id AND covered_through_event_id <= last_event_id AND starts_after_event_id <= covered_through_event_id)
)

CREATE TRIGGER trg_canonical_conversations_primary_alias_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF primary_alias_id, primary_marker ON canonical_conversations
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'canonical conversation primary alias pointer is immutable')
    WHERE NEW.primary_alias_id IS NOT OLD.primary_alias_id
       OR NEW.primary_marker IS NOT OLD.primary_marker;
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_conversation_legacy_aliases_primary_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON conversation_legacy_aliases
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'pinned primary alias cannot be deleted')
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM canonical_conversations
        WHERE id = OLD.conversation_id AND primary_alias_id = OLD.id
    );
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_conversation_legacy_aliases_primary_update
BEFORE UPDATE ON conversation_legacy_aliases
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'pinned primary alias cannot be changed')
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM canonical_conversations
        WHERE id = OLD.conversation_id AND primary_alias_id = OLD.id
    )
    AND (
        NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id
        OR NEW.conversation_id IS NOT OLD.conversation_id
        OR NEW.is_primary IS NOT OLD.is_primary
        OR NEW.scope_key IS NOT OLD.scope_key
    );
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_identity_bindings_route_consistency_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF person_id, platform ON identity_bindings
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'identity binding update would break person active route')
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM person_active_routes AS route
        JOIN presences AS presence ON presence.id = route.presence_id
        WHERE route.identity_binding_id = NEW.id
          AND (
            route.person_id IS NOT NEW.person_id
            OR NEW.platform IS NOT presence.platform
          )
    );
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_person_active_routes_consistency_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON person_active_routes
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'person active route ownership or platform mismatch')
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM identity_bindings AS binding
        JOIN presences AS presence ON presence.id = NEW.presence_id
        WHERE binding.id = NEW.identity_binding_id
          AND binding.person_id = NEW.person_id
          AND binding.platform = presence.platform
    );
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_presences_route_consistency_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF platform ON presences
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'presence platform update would break routes')
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM person_active_routes AS route
        JOIN identity_bindings AS binding ON binding.id = route.identity_binding_id
        WHERE route.presence_id = NEW.id
          AND binding.platform IS NOT NEW.platform
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM space_binding_ingest_routes AS route
        JOIN space_bindings AS binding ON binding.id = route.space_binding_id
        WHERE route.ingest_presence_id = NEW.id
          AND binding.platform IS NOT NEW.platform
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM space_active_routes AS route
        JOIN space_bindings AS binding ON binding.id = route.space_binding_id
        WHERE route.presence_id = NEW.id
          AND binding.platform IS NOT NEW.platform
    );
END

BEFORE UPDATE OF space_id, platform ON space_bindings

        SELECT 1
        FROM space_active_routes AS route
        JOIN presences AS presence ON presence.id = route.presence_id
        WHERE route.space_binding_id = NEW.id
          AND (
            route.space_id IS NOT NEW.space_id
            OR NEW.platform IS NOT presence.platform
          )
    );
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_canonical_conversations_primary_alias_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF primary_alias_id, primary_marker ON canonical_conversations
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'canonical conversation primary alias pointer is immutable')
    WHERE NEW.primary_alias_id IS NOT OLD.primary_alias_id
       OR NEW.primary_marker IS NOT OLD.primary_marker;
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_conversation_legacy_aliases_primary_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON conversation_legacy_aliases
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'pinned primary alias cannot be deleted')
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM canonical_conversations
        WHERE id = OLD.conversation_id AND primary_alias_id = OLD.id
    );
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_conversation_legacy_aliases_primary_update
BEFORE UPDATE ON conversation_legacy_aliases
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'pinned primary alias cannot be changed')
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM canonical_conversations
        WHERE id = OLD.conversation_id AND primary_alias_id = OLD.id
    )
    AND (
        NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id
        OR NEW.conversation_id IS NOT OLD.conversation_id
        OR NEW.is_primary IS NOT OLD.is_primary
        OR NEW.scope_key IS NOT OLD.scope_key
    );
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_identity_bindings_route_consistency_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF person_id, platform ON identity_bindings
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'identity binding update would break person active route')
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM person_active_routes AS route
        JOIN presences AS presence ON presence.id = route.presence_id
        WHERE route.identity_binding_id = NEW.id
          AND (
            route.person_id IS NOT NEW.person_id
            OR NEW.platform IS NOT presence.platform
          )
    );
END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_person_active_routes_consistency_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON person_active_routes
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'person active route ownership or platform mismatch')
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM identity_bindings AS binding
        JOIN presences AS presence ON presence.id = NEW.presence_id
        WHERE binding.id = NEW.identity_binding_id
          AND binding.person_id = NEW.person_id
          AND binding.platform = presence.platform
    );
END

END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_presences_route_consistency_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF platform ON presences
BEGIN

    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM person_active_routes AS route
        JOIN identity_bindings AS binding ON binding.id = route.identity_binding_id
        WHERE route.presence_id = NEW.id
          AND binding.platform IS NOT NEW.platform
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM space_binding_ingest_routes AS route
        JOIN space_bindings AS binding ON binding.id = route.space_binding_id
        WHERE route.ingest_presence_id = NEW.id
          AND binding.platform IS NOT NEW.platform
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM space_active_routes AS route
        JOIN space_bindings AS binding ON binding.id = route.space_binding_id
        WHERE route.presence_id = NEW.id
          AND binding.platform IS NOT NEW.platform
    );
END

UPDATE identity_bindings SET first_seen_at = MIN(created_at, updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT p.first_seen_at FROM people p WHERE p.user_id = identity_bindings.external_account_id AND identity_bindings.platform = 'qq'), created_at), COALESCE((SELECT p.last_seen_at FROM people p WHERE p.user_id = identity_bindings.external_account_id AND identity_bindings.platform = 'qq'), updated_at)), last_seen_at = MAX(created_at, updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT p.first_seen_at FROM people p WHERE p.user_id = identity_bindings.external_account_id AND identity_bindings.platform = 'qq'), created_at), COALESCE((SELECT p.last_seen_at FROM people p WHERE p.user_id = identity_bindings.external_account_id AND identity_bindings.platform = 'qq'), updated_at))

UPDATE space_bindings SET first_seen_at = MIN(created_at, updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT g.first_seen_at FROM groups g WHERE g.group_id = space_bindings.external_space_id AND space_bindings.platform = 'qq'), created_at), COALESCE((SELECT g.last_seen_at FROM groups g WHERE g.group_id = space_bindings.external_space_id AND space_bindings.platform = 'qq'), updated_at), COALESCE((SELECT g.updated_at FROM groups g WHERE g.group_id = space_bindings.external_space_id AND space_bindings.platform = 'qq'), updated_at)), last_seen_at = MAX(created_at, updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT g.first_seen_at FROM groups g WHERE g.group_id = space_bindings.external_space_id AND space_bindings.platform = 'qq'), created_at), COALESCE((SELECT g.last_seen_at FROM groups g WHERE g.group_id = space_bindings.external_space_id AND space_bindings.platform = 'qq'), updated_at), COALESCE((SELECT g.updated_at FROM groups g WHERE g.group_id = space_bindings.external_space_id AND space_bindings.platform = 'qq'), updated_at))
UPDATE identity_bindings SET display_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(display_name, ''), (SELECT p.nickname FROM people p WHERE p.user_id = external_account_id AND platform = 'qq'), '')
UPDATE space_bindings SET display_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(display_name, ''), (SELECT g.name FROM groups g WHERE g.group_id = external_space_id AND platform = 'qq'), '')
UPDATE spaces SET name = COALESCE(NULLIF(name, ''), (SELECT g.name FROM groups g WHERE g.canonical_space_id = spaces.id ORDER BY g.last_seen_at DESC LIMIT 1), '')

UPDATE persons SET created_at = MIN(created_at, updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(b.first_seen_at) FROM identity_bindings b WHERE b.person_id = persons.id), created_at)), updated_at = MAX(created_at, updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(b.last_seen_at) FROM identity_bindings b WHERE b.person_id = persons.id), updated_at))

UPDATE spaces SET created_at = MIN(created_at, updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(b.first_seen_at) FROM space_bindings b WHERE b.space_id = spaces.id), created_at)), updated_at = MAX(created_at, updated_at, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(b.last_seen_at) FROM space_bindings b WHERE b.space_id = spaces.id), updated_at))

UPDATE chat_events AS reply
        SET caused_by_event_id = (
            SELECT MIN(outbox.source_event_id)
            FROM plugin_notification_outbox AS outbox
            JOIN chat_events AS source ON source.id = outbox.source_event_id
            WHERE outbox.platform_message_id = reply.platform_message_id
              AND outbox.canonical_conversation_id = reply.canonical_conversation_id
              AND source.canonical_conversation_id = reply.canonical_conversation_id
              AND source.id < reply.id
              AND source.event_kind = 'external_event'
              AND source.direction = 'external'
              AND source.origin = 'plugin_background'
              AND source.suppression_status = 'keeper'
            GROUP BY outbox.platform_message_id, outbox.canonical_conversation_id
            HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT outbox.source_event_id) = 1
        )
        WHERE reply.event_kind = 'message'
          AND reply.direction = 'outbound'
          AND reply.origin = 'plugin_background'
          AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM plugin_notification_outbox AS candidate
            WHERE candidate.platform_message_id = reply.platform_message_id
              AND candidate.canonical_conversation_id = reply.canonical_conversation_id
          )

    WHEN OLD.generation IS NOT NEW.generation OR OLD.starts_after_event_id IS NOT NEW.starts_after_event_id
    BEGIN

migrations.purpose:
Give every legacy effect receipt one canonical ``outcome``.

Receipts written before typed outcomes carried only a serialized ``result``
(or an empty ``outcome``). SQL then had to re-parse that text to decide pending
and unknown. This migration decodes it once, with a frozen copy of the pure
decoder, and stores the canonical projection; ``result``, media, opaque and
journal data are untouched. Undecodable rows become explicit unknown. Each row
is written with a CAS on its original bytes, paged by primary key, so re-running
is a no-op.

INSERT INTO prompt_projections (
            view_key, conversation_id, generation, source_revision, starts_after_event_id,
            epoch_id, context_key, revision, rebuild_reason, invalidated_reason,
            payload_json, byte_size, updated_at, selected_summary_text,
            selected_summary_coverage, selected_summary_kind, selected_summary_renderer
        )
        SELECT c.id, c.id, c.generation, c.prompt_source_revision, c.starts_after_event_id,
            lower(hex(randomblob(16))), 'compact-upgrade', 1, 'compact', 'compact',
            '[]', 2, r.updated_at, r.summary_text, r.covered_through_event_id, 'compact', 2
        FROM canonical_conversation_rollups AS r
        JOIN canonical_conversations AS c ON c.id=r.conversation_id
        WHERE r.generation=c.generation AND trim(r.summary_text) <> ''
          AND r.summary_kind IN ('model', 'extractive', 'migration')
          AND r.covered_through_event_id BETWEEN c.starts_after_event_id AND c.last_event_id
        ON CONFLICT(view_key) DO NOTHING

UPDATE prompt_projections AS p
        SET generation=c.generation, source_revision=c.prompt_source_revision,
            starts_after_event_id=c.starts_after_event_id,
            selected_summary_text=r.summary_text,
            selected_summary_coverage=r.covered_through_event_id,
            selected_summary_kind='compact', selected_summary_renderer=2,
            payload_json='[]', byte_size=2, revision=p.revision+1,
            invalidated_reason='compact'
        FROM canonical_conversation_rollups AS r
        JOIN canonical_conversations AS c ON c.id=r.conversation_id
        WHERE p.view_key=c.id AND p.conversation_id=c.id AND r.generation=c.generation
          AND trim(r.summary_text) <> ''
          AND r.summary_kind IN ('model', 'extractive', 'migration')
          AND r.covered_through_event_id BETWEEN c.starts_after_event_id AND c.last_event_id
          AND NOT (p.generation=c.generation
            AND p.starts_after_event_id=c.starts_after_event_id
            AND p.source_revision=c.prompt_source_revision
            AND coalesce(trim(p.selected_summary_text), '') <> ''
            AND p.selected_summary_coverage BETWEEN c.starts_after_event_id AND c.last_event_id)

UPDATE runtime_work
        SET checkpoint_json=json_remove(checkpoint_json,'$.context_rollup'),
            state='queued', reason='context_prepared', revision=revision+1
        WHERE state='waiting_external'

        SET selected_summary_kind='compact', selected_summary_renderer=2,
            payload_json='[]', byte_size=2, revision=p.revision+1,

        FROM canonical_conversations AS c
        WHERE p.conversation_id=c.id AND p.generation=c.generation
          AND p.starts_after_event_id=c.starts_after_event_id
          AND p.source_revision=c.prompt_source_revision
          AND p.selected_summary_text IS NOT NULL AND trim(p.selected_summary_text) <> ''
          AND p.selected_summary_coverage BETWEEN c.starts_after_event_id AND c.last_event_id

            SELECT j.canonical_conversation_id FROM plugin_background_turn_jobs j
            WHERE j.plugin_id=g.plugin_id AND j.canonical_conversation_id IS NOT NULL
              AND ((g.target_type='private' AND j.canonical_target_person_id=g.canonical_target_person_id)
                OR (g.target_type='group' AND j.canonical_target_space_id=g.canonical_target_space_id))
          ) HAVING count(*)=1
        )

          SELECT min(c.id) FROM canonical_conversations c
          WHERE (g.target_type='private' AND c.person_id=g.canonical_target_person_id
                 AND c.entry_presence_id=g.canonical_presence_id)
             OR (g.target_type='group' AND c.space_id=g.canonical_target_space_id
                 AND c.space_binding_id IN (SELECT b.id FROM space_bindings b JOIN presences p
                     ON p.id=g.canonical_presence_id AND b.platform=p.platform
                     WHERE b.space_id=g.canonical_target_space_id))
          HAVING count(*)=1
        ) WHERE g.canonical_conversation_id IS NULL

UPDATE memory_rebuild_proposals AS proposal SET
            canonical_subject_person_id = CASE
                WHEN proposal.scope_type NOT IN ('person', 'person_group') THEN NULL
                WHEN proposal.actual_fact_id IS NOT NULL THEN (
                    SELECT canonical_subject_person_id FROM memory_facts
                    WHERE id = proposal.actual_fact_id)
                WHEN json_valid(proposal.claim_json) AND
                     json_extract(proposal.claim_json, '$.subject_ref') = 'speaker' THEN (
                    SELECT author_person_id FROM chat_events WHERE id = proposal.event_id)
                WHEN json_valid(proposal.claim_json) AND
                     substr(json_extract(proposal.claim_json, '$.subject_ref'), 1, 7) = 'member_' THEN (
                    SELECT id FROM persons WHERE id =
                        substr(json_extract(proposal.claim_json, '$.subject_ref'), 8))
                WHEN json_valid(proposal.claim_json) AND
                     json_extract(proposal.claim_json, '$.subject_ref') = 'reply_author' THEN (
                    SELECT reply.author_person_id FROM chat_events AS source
                    JOIN chat_events AS reply ON reply.id = source.reply_to_event_id
                    WHERE source.id = proposal.event_id
                        AND reply.canonical_conversation_id = source.canonical_conversation_id)
                ELSE NULL END,
            canonical_subject_space_id = CASE
                WHEN proposal.scope_type NOT IN ('group', 'person_group') THEN NULL
                WHEN proposal.actual_fact_id IS NOT NULL THEN (
                    SELECT canonical_subject_space_id FROM memory_facts
                    WHERE id = proposal.actual_fact_id)
                ELSE (
                    SELECT conversation.space_id FROM chat_events AS source
                    JOIN canonical_conversations AS conversation
                        ON conversation.id = source.canonical_conversation_id
                    WHERE source.id = proposal.event_id AND conversation.kind = 'space')

BEFORE INSERT ON person_active_routes

    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'person active route ownership or platform mismatch')

CREATE TRIGGER
    prompt_projection_event_metadata_update AFTER UPDATE OF id, bot_user_id, platform_message_id, scope_type, group_id, private_peer_user_id, sender_user_id, sender_nickname, sender_group_card, direction, event_kind, source_plugin_id, external_source, external_event_key, external_event_type, external_resume_wait, external_target_id, reply_to_message_id, reply_to_event_id, origin, automation_id, automation_run_id, occurred_at, observed_at, canonical_event_id, author_kind, author_person_id, author_presence_id, ingress_presence_id, utterance_fingerprint, ingress_provider, ingress_gateway_instance_id, caused_by_event_id, author_account_id ON chat_events
    WHEN OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id OR OLD.bot_user_id IS NOT NEW.bot_user_id OR OLD.platform_message_id IS NOT NEW.platform_message_id OR OLD.scope_type IS NOT NEW.scope_type OR OLD.group_id IS NOT NEW.group_id OR OLD.private_peer_user_id IS NOT NEW.private_peer_user_id OR OLD.sender_user_id IS NOT NEW.sender_user_id OR OLD.sender_nickname IS NOT NEW.sender_nickname OR OLD.sender_group_card IS NOT NEW.sender_group_card OR OLD.direction IS NOT NEW.direction OR OLD.event_kind IS NOT NEW.event_kind OR OLD.source_plugin_id IS NOT NEW.source_plugin_id OR OLD.external_source IS NOT NEW.external_source OR OLD.external_event_key IS NOT NEW.external_event_key OR OLD.external_event_type IS NOT NEW.external_event_type OR OLD.external_resume_wait IS NOT NEW.external_resume_wait OR OLD.external_target_id IS NOT NEW.external_target_id OR OLD.reply_to_message_id IS NOT NEW.reply_to_message_id OR OLD.reply_to_event_id IS NOT NEW.reply_to_event_id OR OLD.origin IS NOT NEW.origin OR OLD.automation_id IS NOT NEW.automation_id OR OLD.automation_run_id IS NOT NEW.automation_run_id OR OLD.occurred_at IS NOT NEW.occurred_at OR OLD.observed_at IS NOT NEW.observed_at OR OLD.canonical_event_id IS NOT NEW.canonical_event_id OR OLD.author_kind IS NOT NEW.author_kind OR OLD.author_person_id IS NOT NEW.author_person_id OR OLD.author_presence_id IS NOT NEW.author_presence_id OR OLD.ingress_presence_id IS NOT NEW.ingress_presence_id OR OLD.utterance_fingerprint IS NOT NEW.utterance_fingerprint OR OLD.ingress_provider IS NOT NEW.ingress_provider OR OLD.ingress_gateway_instance_id IS NOT NEW.ingress_gateway_instance_id OR OLD.caused_by_event_id IS NOT NEW.caused_by_event_id OR OLD.author_account_id IS NOT NEW.author_account_id
    BEGIN
        UPDATE canonical_conversations SET prompt_source_revision=prompt_source_revision+1
        WHERE id IN (OLD.canonical_conversation_id, NEW.canonical_conversation_id);
    END

CREATE TABLE chat_events (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	bot_user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	platform_message_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	scope_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	group_id VARCHAR(64), 
	private_peer_user_id VARCHAR(64),

	sender_group_card VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,

	source_plugin_id VARCHAR(128), 
	external_source VARCHAR(64), 
	external_event_key VARCHAR(255),

	audio_transcript TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	segments_json TEXT NOT NULL,

	automation_id INTEGER, 
	automation_run_id INTEGER,

	observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	canonical_event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	canonical_conversation_id VARCHAR(36), 
	author_account_id VARCHAR(36), 
	author_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	author_person_id VARCHAR(36), 
	author_presence_id VARCHAR(36), 
	ingress_presence_id VARCHAR(36), 
	utterance_fingerprint VARCHAR(64), 
	suppression_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	ingress_provider VARCHAR(32), 
	ingress_gateway_instance_id VARCHAR(128), 
	caused_by_event_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_kind_payload CHECK ((event_kind = 'message' AND source_plugin_id IS NULL AND external_source IS NULL AND external_event_key IS NULL AND external_event_type IS NULL AND external_payload_json IS NULL AND external_target_id IS NULL) OR (event_kind = 'external_event' AND source_plugin_id IS NOT NULL AND external_source IS NOT NULL AND external_event_key IS NOT NULL AND external_event_type IS NOT NULL AND external_payload_json IS NOT NULL AND external_target_id IS NOT NULL AND origin = 'plugin_background' AND direction = 'external')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_author_kind CHECK (author_kind IN ('person', 'yuki', 'external_bot', 'system', 'account')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_canonical_event_id CHECK (length(canonical_event_id) = 36 AND canonical_event_id = lower(canonical_event_id) AND canonical_event_id GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-4[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[89ab][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_author CHECK ((author_kind = 'account' AND author_account_id IS NOT NULL AND author_person_id IS NULL AND author_presence_id IS NULL) OR (author_kind = 'person' AND author_person_id IS NOT NULL AND author_presence_id IS NULL AND author_account_id IS NULL) OR (author_kind = 'yuki' AND author_person_id IS NULL AND author_presence_id IS NOT NULL AND author_account_id IS NULL) OR (author_kind IN ('external_bot', 'system') AND author_person_id IS NULL AND author_presence_id IS NULL AND author_account_id IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_conversation CHECK (canonical_conversation_id IS NOT NULL OR (author_kind = 'account' AND scope_type = 'private' AND direction = 'inbound')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_suppression_status CHECK (suppression_status IN ('keeper', 'duplicate')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_duplicate_fingerprint CHECK (suppression_status != 'duplicate' OR utterance_fingerprint IS NOT NULL), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reply_to_event_id) REFERENCES chat_events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(automation_id) REFERENCES automations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(automation_run_id) REFERENCES automation_runs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(canonical_conversation_id) REFERENCES canonical_conversations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_person_id) REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_presence_id) REFERENCES account_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(ingress_presence_id) REFERENCES account_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(caused_by_event_id) REFERENCES chat_events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)

BEFORE UPDATE OF id,account_id,kind,person_id ON account_assignments
BEGIN
 SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'original assignment identity is immutable')
 WHERE NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.account_id IS NOT OLD.account_id
    OR NEW.kind IS NOT OLD.kind OR NEW.person_id IS NOT OLD.person_id;
END

BEFORE UPDATE OF id,platform,external_account_id ON accounts
BEGIN
 SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'stable account identity is immutable')
 WHERE NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.platform IS NOT OLD.platform
    OR NEW.external_account_id IS NOT OLD.external_account_id;
END

 SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'an ended assignment cannot be resumed');

CREATE TRIGGER trg_space_bindings_route_consistency_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF space_id,platform ON space_bindings
BEGIN
 SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'space binding update would break space routes')
 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_binding_ingest_routes route
  JOIN account_assignments presence ON presence.id=route.ingest_presence_id
  JOIN accounts account ON account.id=presence.account_id
  WHERE route.space_binding_id=NEW.id AND NEW.platform IS NOT account.platform)
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM space_active_routes route
  JOIN account_assignments presence ON presence.id=route.presence_id
  JOIN accounts account ON account.id=presence.account_id
  WHERE route.space_binding_id=NEW.id
    AND (route.space_id IS NOT NEW.space_id OR NEW.platform IS NOT account.platform));
END

BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'canonical conversation primary alias pointer is immutable')
    WHERE NEW.primary_alias_id IS NOT OLD.primary_alias_id
       OR NEW.primary_marker IS NOT OLD.primary_marker;
END

        WHERE id = OLD.conversation_id AND primary_alias_id = OLD.id

        OR NEW.conversation_id IS NOT OLD.conversation_id
        OR NEW.is_primary IS NOT OLD.is_primary
        OR NEW.scope_key IS NOT OLD.scope_key
    );
END

    OR OLD.starts_after_event_id IS NOT NEW.starts_after_event_id

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_runtime_effects_engine_call ON runtime_work_effects (work_id, json_extract(receipt_json, '$.invocation.parent_effect_key'), json_extract(receipt_json, '$.invocation.feed_index'), json_extract(receipt_json, '$.invocation.engine_call_id')) WHERE json_extract(receipt_json, '$.invocation.version') = 1 AND json_type(receipt_json, '$.invocation.parent_effect_key') = 'text'
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_runtime_effects_

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS protocol_object_insert AFTER INSERT ON runtime_protocol_objects
    BEGIN UPDATE runtime_protocol_usage SET byte_size=byte_size+NEW.byte_size WHERE id=1; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS protocol_object_delete AFTER DELETE ON runtime_protocol_objects
    BEGIN UPDATE runtime_protocol_usage SET byte_size=byte_size-OLD.byte_size WHERE id=1; END
